import {bearing} from './bearing.js';
import {readSpriteBank} from './indexed-screen.js';

function readOverlay(bytes, name) {
  if (bytes.length <= 768) throw new Error('Invalid map overlay: ' + name);
  const palette = bytes.slice(0,768), pixels = new Uint8Array(64000);
  let input = 768, output = 0;
  while (input < bytes.length) {
    const flags = bytes[input++];
    for (let mask = 128; mask && input < bytes.length; mask >>= 1) {
      if (!(flags & mask)) {
        if (output >= pixels.length) throw new Error('Map overlay is too large: ' + name);
        pixels[output++] = bytes[input++];
      } else {
        if (input+1 >= bytes.length) throw new Error('Incomplete map overlay: ' + name);
        const code = bytes[input] | bytes[input+1]<<8;
        input += 2;
        const distance = (code & 2047) || 2048, length = (code >>> 11) + 3;
        if (distance > output || output+length > pixels.length) throw new Error('Invalid map overlay match: ' + name);
        for (let i=0; i<length; i++, output++) pixels[output] = pixels[output-distance];
      }
    }
  }
  if (output !== pixels.length) throw new Error('Incomplete map overlay: ' + name);
  return {palette,pixels};
}

// Both map blitters use four planar sprite streams and a 640-pixel virtual page.
// 0x23552 copies every pixel of a bay icon. 0x23361 skips zero in moving markers.
function stamp(pixels, pitch, sprite, left, top, transparent) {
  const {width,height,pixels:source} = sprite;
  const stride = width/4;
  for (let y=0; y<height; y++) {
    const row = top+y;
    if (row < 0 || row >= pixels.length/pitch) continue;
    for (let x=0; x<width; x++) {
      const column = left+x;
      if (column < 0 || column >= pitch) continue;
      const ink = source[((x&3)*height+y)*stride+(x>>2)];
      if (!transparent || ink) pixels[row*pitch+column] = ink;
    }
  }
}

export async function loadMapBackground(bytes) {
  const layers = await Promise.all([1,2,3,4].map(async number => {
    const name = 'KEMOMAP'+number+'.ZZZ';
    return readOverlay(await bytes(name),name);
  }));
  const palette = layers[3].palette;
  const background = new Uint8Array(640*400);
  layers.forEach(({pixels},i) => {
    const start = (i>>1)*200*640+(i&1)*320;
    for (let y=0; y<200; y++) background.set(pixels.subarray(320*y,320*y+320),start+640*y);
  });
  return {palette,background};
}

export async function loadMap(bytes, district, settings) {
  const [{palette,background},iconBytes,bays] = await Promise.all([
    loadMapBackground(bytes), bytes('MAPICONS.SPR'), bytes('BAY'+district+'.DAT'),
  ]);
  const icons = readSpriteBank(iconBytes,139);
  if (settings.colors) {
    palette.set(settings.colors.slice(0,3*(settings.endColor-settings.firstColor)),3*settings.firstColor);
  }
  const data = new DataView(bays.buffer,bays.byteOffset,bays.byteLength);
  if (data.byteLength%40) throw new Error('Incomplete bay record in district '+district);
  const locations = [];
  for (let at=0; at<data.byteLength; at+=40) {
    const type = data.getInt16(at,true);
    const x = data.getInt32(at+4,true), y = data.getInt32(at+8,true);
    const px = Math.trunc(x*settings.scaleX/settings.divisorX);
    const py = Math.trunc(y*settings.scaleY/settings.divisorY);
    if (type >= 0 && type < 5) stamp(background,640,icons[127+type],px+2,py+2,false);
    if (type) locations.push({x,y,px,py,type,district:data.getInt16(at+2,true)});
  }
  return {palette,background,icons,locations};
}

// 0x51710 computes cab-minus-bay deltas in district cells. 0x2E89F
// rotates that bearing into one of the eight WAYP2 instrument lamps.
function waypointDelta(car, bay, settings) {
  return [
    Math.trunc(car.x/512)-Math.trunc(bay.x/512)+Math.trunc(settings.offsetX/2),
    Math.trunc(car.y/512)-Math.trunc(bay.y/512)+Math.trunc(settings.offsetY/2),
  ];
}

export function tickWayfinder(car,settings) {
  const bay = car.waypoint;
  if (!bay) {
    car.arrivedWaypoint = null;
    return false;
  }
  const [dx,dy] = waypointDelta(car,bay,settings);
  if (dx || dy) {
    car.arrivedWaypoint = null;
    return false;
  }
  car.wayfinderPhase = (car.wayfinderPhase+1)&7;
  const arrived = car.arrivedWaypoint !== bay;
  car.arrivedWaypoint = bay;
  return arrived;
}

export function cockpitWayfinder(canvas,wayfinder,district,crt = false) {
  const settings = district.start.mapDisplay;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const image = ctx.createImageData(canvas.width,canvas.height);
  const pixels = new Uint8Array(canvas.width*canvas.height);
  const blit = (i,x,y) => stamp(pixels,canvas.width,wayfinder[i],x-254,y-3,true);
  let previousArrow, previousValue, previousType;
  return car => {
    const bay = car.waypoint;
    const [dx,dy] = bay ? waypointDelta(car,bay,settings) : [0,0];
    const arrow = !bay ? -1 : dx || dy ?
      Math.floor(((bearing(dx,dy,settings.bearings)+Math.trunc(car.angle/16)+101)%360)/45) : car.wayfinderPhase;
    const value = Math.trunc(settings.distanceScale*Math.hypot(dx,dy)), type = bay?.type ?? 0;
    if (arrow === previousArrow && value === previousValue && type === previousType) return false;
    previousArrow = arrow; previousValue = value; previousType = type;
    pixels.fill(0);
    if (!crt) blit(32,262,6);
    settings.arrowPositions.forEach(([x,y],i) => blit(i === arrow ? i : i+8,x,y));
    const label = [undefined,16,19,18,19][type];
    if (label !== undefined) blit(label,270,22);
    const digits = String(value%10000).padStart(4,'0');
    if (bay) {
      [270,274,282,286].forEach((x,i) => blit(22+Number(digits[i]),x,28));
      blit(21,278,28);
    }
    for (let i=0; i<pixels.length; i++) {
      const color = 3*pixels[i];
      for (let c=0; c<3; c++) {
        const v = district.palette[color+c];
        image.data[4*i+c] = (v<<2)|(v>>4);
      }
      image.data[4*i+3] = pixels[i] ? 255 : 0;
    }
    ctx.putImageData(image,0,0);
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label',bay ?
      'Wayfinder, '+settings.bayNames[type]+', '+digits.slice(0,2)+'.'+digits.slice(2) : 'Wayfinder, no destination');
    return image;
  };
}

export function createMapView(display, map, car, settings, onSelection) {
  const frame = new Uint8Array(320*200);
  const player = {
    x:Math.trunc(car.x)+settings.offsetX*256, y:Math.trunc(car.y)+settings.offsetY*256,
    px:Math.trunc(car.x*settings.scaleX/settings.divisorX)+settings.offsetX,
    py:Math.trunc(car.y*settings.scaleY/settings.divisorY)+settings.offsetY,
  };
  const heading = Math.floor(((Math.trunc(car.angle/16)+22)%359)/45);
  const clamp = (n,min,max) => Math.max(min,Math.min(max,n));
  let target = car.waypoint ?? player;
  let left = clamp(player.px-160,0,319), top = clamp(player.py-100,50,239);
  // The first 40 lines of KEMOMAP1 are the fixed instrument strip. The
  // scrolling VGA window occupies the other 160 lines (last origin Y = 239).
  const strip = new Uint8Array(320*40);
  let dirty = true, paletteChanged = true, phase = 0;
  function updateStrip() {
    for (let y=0; y<40; y++) strip.set(map.background.subarray(y*640,y*640+320),y*320);
    function line(text,y) {
      let x = 52;
      for (const ch of text) {
        const glyph = map.icons[ch.charCodeAt(0)-32];
        if (glyph) stamp(strip,320,glyph,x,y,true);
        x += 4;
      }
    }
    if (target === player) line(settings.currentLocation,5);
    else {
      line(settings.bayNames[target.type] ?? '',5);
      line(settings.districtNames[target.district] ?? '',13);
      const dx = Math.trunc((target.x-settings.offsetX*256)/512)-Math.trunc(car.x/512);
      const dy = Math.trunc((target.y-settings.offsetY*256)/512)-Math.trunc(car.y/512);
      const units = Math.trunc(Math.hypot(dx,dy)*settings.distanceScale);
      line(settings.distanceFormat.replace('%d',Math.trunc(units/100)).replace('%d',units%100),21);
    }
    dirty = true;
  }
  updateStrip();
  function select(location) {
    if (target === location) return;
    target = location;
    car.waypoint = location;
    onSelection?.();
    updateStrip();
  }
  return {
    invalidate() { dirty = true; },
    move(dx,dy) {
      const direction = dx < 0 ? 180 : dx > 0 ? 0 : dy < 0 ? 270 : 90;
      let closest = null, best = 0x7fff0000;
      for (const location of map.locations) {
        if (location === target) continue;
        const x = (location.x-target.x)>>9, y = (location.y-target.y)>>9;
        const distance = x*x+y*y;
        const delta = Math.abs(bearing(x,y,settings.bearings)-direction);
        if (Math.min(delta,360-delta) <= 45 && distance < best) {
          best = distance;
          closest = location;
        }
      }
      if (closest) select(closest);
    },
    selectAt(x,y) {
      if (x < 0 || x >= 320 || y < 0 || y >= 160) return;
      let closest = null, best = Infinity;
      for (const location of map.locations) {
        const icon = map.icons[127+location.type];
        if (!icon) continue;
        const cx = location.px+2+icon.width/2-left, cy = location.py+2+icon.height/2-top;
        const dx = x-cx, dy = y-cy;
        if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.max(5,icon.width/2) || Math.abs(dy) > Math.max(5,icon.height/2)) continue;
        const distance = dx*dx+dy*dy;
        if (distance < best) { best = distance; closest = location; }
      }
      if (closest) select(closest);
    },
    draw(elapsed) {
      // 0x4FC48 steps in pixels. 0x520EA also passes the horizontal position
      // to the VGA panning helper after programming the coarse page address.
      phase += elapsed*70;
      const steps = Math.floor(phase);
      phase -= steps;
      const x = left+clamp(clamp(target.px-160,0,319)-left,-steps,steps);
      const y = top+clamp(clamp(target.py-100,40,239)-top,-steps,steps);
      if (!dirty && x === left && y === top) return;
      left = x; top = y;
      for (let row=0; row<160; row++) {
        const start = (top+row)*640+left;
        frame.set(map.background.subarray(start,start+320),row*320);
      }
      stamp(frame,320,map.icons[settings.headingIcons[heading]],player.px-left,player.py-top,true);
      stamp(frame,320,map.icons[135],target.px-left-3,target.py-top-3,true);
      frame.set(strip,160*320);
      display.presentIndexed(frame,map.palette,true,true,paletteChanged);
      dirty = false;
      paletteChanged = false;
    },
  };
}

import {readSpriteBank} from './indexed-screen.js';
import {readDistrict} from './district.js';
import {createCabView, prepareCabPipelines} from './cab-view.js';
import {driveTick, engageNitro, newDriver, selectCabView, startHover, ticksPerSecond, turnView, updateChaseCamera, zoomChase} from './driving.js';
import {createConsole} from './console.js';
import {loadDrivingSounds,createDrivingAudio} from './driving-audio.js';
import {createDrivingDisc} from './cd-audio.js';
import {loadMap, createMapView, cockpitWayfinder, tickWayfinder} from './map-view.js';
import {settings, settingsPanel, openSettings} from './settings.js';

const coldRows = [0, 2, 4];
const labels = ['New Game', 'Resume', 'Load', 'Save', 'Quit Game'];
const menuX = 88;

// Consume a single DOS-style key press. Holding Enter across a fade should
// not select the first slot on the next screen.
function readKey(screen, {pointerKey, pointerHover, buttons, activationEvent = 'pointerdown'} = {}) {
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    const events = new AbortController();
    const options = {signal: events.signal};
    function finish(key) {
      events.abort();
      resolve(key);
    }
    buttons?.addEventListener('click', event => {
      if (event.target instanceof HTMLButtonElement) finish(event.target.value);
    }, options);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if (event.repeat || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.altKey) return;
      if (event.key === 'Tab' || (buttons?.contains(event.target) && ['Enter', ' '].includes(event.key))) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      finish(event.code === 'Backquote' ? 'Backquote' : event.key);
    }, options);
    function pointerPosition(event) {
      const rect = screen.getBoundingClientRect();
      return {
        x: (event.clientX - rect.left) * 320 / rect.width,
        y: (event.clientY - rect.top) * 200 / rect.height,
      };
    }
    screen.addEventListener(activationEvent, event => {
      // Some browsers report isPrimary=false on the synthesized click.
      if (event.button !== 0 || (activationEvent !== 'click' && event.isPrimary === false)) return;
      const key = pointerKey?.(pointerPosition(event));
      if (key !== undefined) finish(key);
    }, options);
    if (pointerHover) screen.addEventListener('pointermove', event => {
      if (event.isPrimary && event.pointerType !== 'touch') pointerHover(pointerPosition(event));
    }, options);
  });
}

async function slotHeader(file) {
  if (!file) return {occupied: false, text: 'NO GAME SAVED'.padEnd(40)};
  const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 41).arrayBuffer());
  const text = Array.from(header.subarray(1), c => String.fromCharCode(c >= 32 && c <= 90 ? c : 32)).join('');
  return {occupied: header[0] === 49, text: text.padEnd(40)};
}

async function loadMenu({screen, vga, tables, bytes, loadImage, getFile, click}) {
  const image = await loadImage('LOADSCR.IMG');
  const saveFont = await bytes('SAVEFONT.SPR');
  const slots = readSpriteBank(saveFont, 120);
  const prompts = readSpriteBank(await bytes('ASKFONT.SPR'), 59);
  const headers = await Promise.all(Array.from({length: 5}, async (_, i) =>
    slotHeader(await getFile('SAVE' + i + '.GAM', true))));
  let selected = 0, mode = 'browse', restore = false;
  const buttons = document.querySelector('#restoreChoice');
  const promptIds = {browse: [1, 2], empty: [7, 8], confirm: [3]};
  function draw() {
    vga.setImage(image);
    headers.forEach(({text}, i) => {
      const active = i === selected;
      vga.sprite(slots[active ? 119 : 118], 12, 45 + i * 23);
      vga.line(text, 44 + i * 23, tables.slotWidths, slots, 30, active ? 59 : 0);
    });
    buttons.hidden = mode !== 'confirm';
    promptIds[mode].forEach((id, i) => vga.line(tables.lines[id], 170 + i * 10, tables.widths, prompts));
    screen.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Load game. Slot ' + (selected + 1) + '. ' + headers[selected].text.trim() + '. ' +
      promptIds[mode].map(id => tables.lines[id]).join(' '));
    vga.present();
  }
  draw();
  await vga.fade(image.dac, true);
  for (;;) {
    // Slot selection and Y/N follow 0x471B4. Taps are browser equivalents.
    const key = await readKey(screen, {
      pointerKey: ({y}) => {
        if (mode === 'empty') return 'Enter';
        if (mode === 'confirm') return;
        if (y >= 44 && y < 159) return Math.floor((y - 44) / 23);
        if (y >= 170) return 'Escape';
      },
      buttons: mode === 'confirm' ? buttons : undefined,
    });
    if (mode === 'empty') mode = 'browse';
    else if (mode === 'confirm') {
      if (key.toLowerCase() === 'y') { click(); restore = true; break; }
      if (key.toLowerCase() === 'n') { click(); mode = 'browse'; }
    } else if (key === 'Escape') break;
    else if (key === 'Enter' || typeof key === 'number') {
      if (typeof key === 'number') selected = key;
      click();
      mode = headers[selected].occupied ? 'confirm' : 'empty';
    } else {
      const next = selected + (key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : key === 'ArrowUp' ? -1 : 0);
      if (next === selected || next < 0 || next > 4) continue;
      selected = next;
      click();
    }
    draw();
  }
  buttons.hidden = true;
  screen.focus();
  await vga.fade(image.dac, false);
  return restore;
}

async function loadFromMenu({screen, display, vga, loadImage, getFile, bytes, tables, audio}, restoring) {
  const image = await loadImage('WAIT.IMG');
  vga.setImage(image);
  vga.present();
  await vga.fade(image.dac, true);
  const hint = document.querySelector('#checkpoint');
  try {
    let message = 'Saved-game restoration stops here.';
    if (!restoring) {
      try {
        const prepared = prepareCabPipelines(display);
        const [district,pipelines,sounds,taxi,wayfinder] = await Promise.all([
          readDistrict(getFile,tables.newGame), prepared, loadDrivingSounds(audio,getFile),
          Promise.all([prepared,import('./taxi-model.js')]).then(([p,{loadTaxi}]) =>
            loadTaxi(display.device,p.taxi.materialLayout)),
          bytes('WAYP2.SPR').then(data => readSpriteBank(data,37)),
        ]);
        district.taxiCenterZ = taxi?.centerZ;
        district.taxiBounds = taxi?.bounds;
        await vga.fade(image.dac, false);
        return {district, pipelines, sounds, taxi, wayfinder, car: newDriver(district), welcome: true, resolution: Infinity};
      } catch (error) {
        message = error.message;
      }
    }
    hint.textContent = message + ' Press a key or tap the game screen to return to the menu.';
    hint.hidden = false;
    screen.setAttribute('aria-label', hint.textContent);
    await readKey(screen, {pointerKey: () => 'Enter'});
  } finally {
    hint.hidden = true;
  }
  await vga.fade(image.dac, false);
}

export async function enterCab({display, screen, getAudioTrack, bytes, audio, click}, session) {
  const {car, district} = session;
  const lastTick = {...car}, visibleCar = {...car};
  const events = new AbortController(), options = {signal: events.signal};
  const held = new Set(), dt = 1/ticksPerSecond;
  const status = document.querySelector('#checkpoint');
  const mouseHint = document.querySelector('#mouseCaptureHint');
  let hideStatus, demoPrompt = null;
  function report(message) {
    if (demoPrompt) return;
    status.textContent = message;
    status.hidden = false;
    if (message.startsWith('CD audio:') || message.startsWith('Sound FX:')) debugConsole?.write(message);
    clearTimeout(hideStatus);
    hideStatus = setTimeout(() => { status.hidden = true; },
      message.startsWith('CD audio:') || message.startsWith('Sound FX:') ? 5000 : 1200);
  }
  function reportMode() { report(view.resolution().join(' × ')); }
  const frameMs = 1000/60;
  const instrument = document.querySelector('#wayfinder');
  let drawInstrument;
  let view, debugConsole, disc, effects, mapView, mapLoading = false, animation, previous, nextFrame, accumulator = 0, fade = 0, leaving = false, fps = 0;
  let resizeNeeded = true, mouseCaptured = false, captureWanted = false, capturePending = false, captureGeneration = 0;
  function drivingInput() {
    return !mapView && !mapLoading && !demoPrompt && !leaving && !settingsPanel.open && document.hasFocus();
  }
  function updateMouseCaptureUI() {
    const active = !events.signal.aborted && drivingInput() && !document.hidden;
    screen.classList.toggle('hide-cursor', active && mouseCaptured);
    mouseHint.hidden = !active || mouseCaptured;
  }
  function releaseMouse() {
    captureWanted = false;
    captureGeneration++;
    mouseCaptured = false;
    if (document.pointerLockElement === screen) document.exitPointerLock();
    updateMouseCaptureUI();
  }
  function release() {
    effects?.setActive(false);
    releaseMouse();
    held.clear();
    accumulator = 0;
    Object.assign(lastTick,car);
    previous = nextFrame = undefined;
  }
  function describe() {
    screen.setAttribute('aria-label', session.welcome ? district.start.welcome.join('. ') :
      'WASD or arrow keys drive and steer. '+
      'Click to capture the mouse and look around. Enter sounds the horn. M opens the map. F switches views. F1, F2 and F3 select left, forward and right cockpit views. '+(session.demo ? 'J or Z jumps. N engages nitro. P pauses. ' : '')+
      'V toggles headlights. Scroll to zoom in chase. '+(session.demo ? '' : 'C changes CD track, P pauses music. ')+'Minus and plus change resolution. Tilde opens settings. Escape '+(session.demo ? 'asks whether to exit.' : 'opens the menu.'));
  }
  function requestExit() {
    if (!session.demo) { leaving = true; held.clear(); return; }
    openDemoPrompt('quit');
  }
  function openDemoPrompt(kind) {
    demoPrompt = kind;
    release();
    clearTimeout(hideStatus);
    status.textContent = kind === 'quit' ? 'ARE YOU SURE YOU WANT TO EXIT? (Y/N)' : 'GAME PAUSED';
    status.hidden = false;
    screen.setAttribute('aria-label',status.textContent);
  }
  function dismiss() { session.welcome = false; describe(); updateMouseCaptureUI(); }
  async function openMap() {
    mapLoading = true;
    effects.stopEngine();
    release();
    try {
      session.map ??= await loadMap(bytes,district.start.district,district.start.mapDisplay);
      if (leaving || events.signal.aborted) return;
      mapView = createMapView(display,session.map,car,district.start.mapDisplay,click);
      screen.width = 320; screen.height = 200;
      screen.classList.remove('driving','hide-cursor');
      screen.setAttribute('aria-label','City map. Click a bay or use arrow keys to select a waypoint. M or Escape returns to driving.');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Unable to open map:', error);
      report('Map: ' + error.message);
    } finally {
      mapLoading = false;
      updateMouseCaptureUI();
    }
  }
  function closeMap() {
    mapView = null;
    screen.classList.add('driving');
    resizeNeeded = true;
    release();
    describe();
  }
  screen.classList.add('driving');
  screen.focus();
  try {
    view = createCabView(screen, display, district, session);
    debugConsole = createConsole(screen,district,car,view);
    effects = createDrivingAudio(audio,session.sounds);
    session.reportCd = report;
    if (!session.demo && !session.disc) {
      session.disc = createDrivingDisc(getAudioTrack,message => session.reportCd?.(message));
      session.disc.start();
    }
    disc = session.disc;
    if (session.sounds.unavailable.length) report('Sound FX: missing or unreadable '+session.sounds.unavailable.join(', '));
    describe();
    document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (leaving) return;
      if (demoPrompt) {
        if (e.repeat || (demoPrompt === 'quit' && e.code !== 'KeyY' && e.code !== 'KeyN')) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const confirmed = demoPrompt === 'quit' && e.code === 'KeyY';
        demoPrompt = null;
        status.hidden = true;
        if (confirmed) leaving = true;
        else { describe(); updateMouseCaptureUI(); captureMouse(); }
        return;
      }
      if (e.code === 'AltLeft' || e.code === 'AltRight') {
        if (drivingInput() && !session.welcome) held.add(e.code);
        return;
      }
      if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || (e.altKey && !['KeyW','KeyS','KeyA','KeyD',
        'ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Numpad8','Numpad2','Numpad4','Numpad6'].includes(e.code)) || e.key === 'Tab') return;
      if (e.code === 'Backquote') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (e.repeat) return;
        release();
        screen.classList.remove('hide-cursor');
        openSettings(click).then(() => {
          if (events.signal.aborted) return;
          resizeNeeded = true;
          mapView?.invalidate();
          release();
          screen.focus();
        });
        updateMouseCaptureUI();
        return;
      }
      e.preventDefault();
      if (mapView) {
        if (!e.repeat && (e.code === 'Escape' || e.code === 'KeyM')) {
          closeMap();
          captureMouse();
        }
        else if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'Numpad4') mapView.move(-2,0);
        else if (e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'Numpad6') mapView.move(2,0);
        else if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'Numpad8') mapView.move(0,-2);
        else if (e.code === 'ArrowDown' || e.code === 'Numpad2') mapView.move(0,2);
        return;
      }
      if (mapLoading) return;
      if (e.repeat) return;
      if (session.welcome) { dismiss(); captureMouse(); return; }
      if (e.code === 'Escape') requestExit();
      else if ((e.code === 'KeyZ' || (session.demo && e.code === 'KeyJ')) && drivingInput()) startHover(car,session.demo ? 60 : 32);
      else if (session.demo && e.code === 'KeyN' && drivingInput()) {
        if (engageNitro(car)) {
          effects.nitro();
          report('Nitro charges left: '+car.nitroCharges);
        } else if (!car.nitroCharges) report('No nitro charges left');
      }
      else if ((e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'NumpadEnter') && drivingInput()) effects.horn();
      else if (['F1','F2','F3'].includes(e.code) && drivingInput()) {
        selectCabView(car,e.code === 'F1' ? 1 : e.code === 'F3' ? -1 : 0);
      }
      else if (e.code === 'KeyF') {
        car.camera = car.camera ? 0 : 1;
        if (car.camera) {
          car.chaseYaw = car.angle*Math.PI/2880;
          car.chaseIdle = 0;
        } else {
          selectCabView(car);
        }
        captureMouse();
      }
      else if (e.code === 'KeyM') openMap();
      else if (e.code === 'KeyV') {
        car.headlights = !car.headlights;
        report(car.headlights ? 'Headlights on' : 'Headlights off');
      }
      else if (e.code === 'KeyC' || e.code === 'BracketRight') disc?.change(1);
      else if (e.code === 'BracketLeft') disc?.change(-1);
      else if (e.code === 'KeyP') {
        if (session.demo) openDemoPrompt('pause');
        else disc.toggle();
      }
      else if ((e.key === '+' || e.key === '=' || e.code === 'NumpadAdd')) { view.resize(1); reportMode(); }
      else if ((e.key === '-' || e.code === 'NumpadSubtract')) { view.resize(-1); reportMode(); }
      else held.add(e.code);
    }, options);
    document.addEventListener('keyup', e => held.delete(e.code), options);
    document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange', () => {
      const captured = document.pointerLockElement === screen;
      if (mouseCaptured && !captured && drivingInput() && !document.hidden) {
        // Browsers can consume Escape while releasing pointer lock.
        requestExit();
      }
      mouseCaptured = captured;
      if (captured && (!captureWanted || !drivingInput())) releaseMouse();
      else updateMouseCaptureUI();
    }, options);
    async function captureMouse() {
      if (document.pointerLockElement === screen || capturePending || !drivingInput()) return;
      captureWanted = true;
      capturePending = true;
      const generation = captureGeneration;
      try {
        if (typeof screen.requestPointerLock !== 'function') throw new Error('Pointer lock is not supported by this browser.');
        try {
          await screen.requestPointerLock({unadjustedMovement:true});
        } catch (error) {
          if (error.name !== 'NotSupportedError' && !(error instanceof TypeError)) throw error;
          if (generation !== captureGeneration || !drivingInput()) return;
          await screen.requestPointerLock();
        }
        if (events.signal.aborted) {
          if (!screen.classList.contains('driving') && document.pointerLockElement === screen) document.exitPointerLock();
        } else if (generation !== captureGeneration || !drivingInput()) releaseMouse();
      } catch (error) {
        if (generation === captureGeneration && !events.signal.aborted && drivingInput()) {
          captureWanted = false;
          console.warn('Unable to capture the driving mouse:',error);
          report('Mouse capture unavailable. Click the driving view to retry.');
          updateMouseCaptureUI();
        }
      } finally {
        capturePending = false;
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('pointerlockerror', () => {
      if (!capturePending && captureWanted && drivingInput() && !document.pointerLockElement) {
        captureWanted = false;
        console.warn('The browser rejected pointer lock.');
        report('Mouse capture unavailable. Click the driving view to retry.');
        updateMouseCaptureUI();
      }
    }, options);
    screen.addEventListener('click', e => {
      if (e.button !== 0 || settingsPanel.open || leaving) return;
      if (mapView) {
        const rect = screen.getBoundingClientRect();
        mapView.selectAt((e.clientX-rect.left)*320/rect.width,(e.clientY-rect.top)*200/rect.height);
        return;
      }
      if (!drivingInput()) return;
      if (session.welcome) dismiss();
      captureMouse();
    }, options);
    document.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
      if (!car.camera || !drivingInput() || session.welcome || e.ctrlKey ||
          (document.pointerLockElement !== screen && e.target !== screen)) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const unit = e.deltaMode === 1 ? 16 : e.deltaMode === 2 ? screen.clientHeight : 1;
      zoomChase(car,e.deltaY*unit);
    }, {...options,passive:false,capture:true});
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      if (!session.welcome && drivingInput() && document.pointerLockElement === screen) {
        turnView(car,e.movementX,settings.invertY ? -e.movementY : e.movementY,district);
      }
    }, options);
    window.addEventListener('blur', release, options);
    window.addEventListener('focus', updateMouseCaptureUI, options);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', release, options);
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => { resizeNeeded = true; }, options);
    updateMouseCaptureUI();
    await new Promise((done,fail) => {
      function frame(now) {
        try {
          if (mapView) {
            const elapsed = Math.min(0.1,(now-(previous ?? now))/1000);
            previous = now;
            instrument.hidden = true;
            mapView.draw(elapsed);
            debugConsole.update(now,elapsed > 0 ? 1/elapsed : fps);
            animation = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
            return;
          }
          nextFrame ??= now;
          // Keep the 60 Hz phase across 120/144/165 Hz display callbacks.
          // Missed presentation slots expire without a burst of catch-up draws.
          if (now+0.2 < nextFrame) { animation = requestAnimationFrame(frame); return; }
          nextFrame += (1+Math.floor((now+0.2-nextFrame)/frameMs))*frameMs;
          if (resizeNeeded) { view.resize(); resizeNeeded = false; }
          const frameElapsed = (now-(previous ?? now))/1000;
          const elapsed = Math.min(0.1,frameElapsed);
          previous = now;
          if (frameElapsed > 0) fps = fps ? fps*.9 + .1/frameElapsed : 1/frameElapsed;
          fade = Math.max(0,Math.min(1,fade + (leaving ? -1 : 1)*elapsed*2));
          const driving = drivingInput() && !document.hidden;
          effects.setActive(driving);
          if (driving && !session.welcome) {
            accumulator += elapsed;
            while (accumulator >= dt) {
              Object.assign(lastTick,car);
              if (driveTick(car,district,held)) effects.contact();
              if (car.launchSound) effects.launch();
              if (car.mineSound !== null) effects.explode(car.mineSound);
              if (tickWayfinder(car,district.start.mapDisplay)) effects.arrive();
              view.tickMaterials();
              accumulator -= dt;
            }
          }
          if (driving) effects.update(car.velocity ?? (car.speed >> 8));
          const alpha = accumulator/dt;
          visibleCar.x = lastTick.x + (car.x-lastTick.x)*alpha;
          visibleCar.y = lastTick.y + (car.y-lastTick.y)*alpha;
          visibleCar.z = lastTick.z + (car.z-lastTick.z)*alpha;
          visibleCar.seatOffset = lastTick.seatOffset+(car.seatOffset-lastTick.seatOffset)*alpha;
          const rotation = (car.angle-lastTick.angle+8640)%5760-2880;
          visibleCar.angle = lastTick.angle + rotation*alpha;
          if (driving && !session.welcome) {
            const moving = car.x !== lastTick.x || car.y !== lastTick.y;
            updateChaseCamera(car,visibleCar.angle,elapsed,moving);
          }
          visibleCar.steering = lastTick.steering + (car.steering-lastTick.steering)*alpha;
          visibleCar.camera = car.camera;
          visibleCar.headlights = car.headlights;
          visibleCar.braking = driving && !session.welcome && (held.has('KeyS') || held.has('ArrowDown') || held.has('Numpad2')) &&
            !(held.has('KeyW') || held.has('ArrowUp') || held.has('Numpad8'));
          visibleCar.lookYaw = car.lookYaw;
          visibleCar.lookPitch = car.lookPitch;
          visibleCar.chaseYaw = car.chaseYaw;
          visibleCar.chasePitch = car.chasePitch;
          visibleCar.chaseFloorLook = car.chaseFloorLook;
          visibleCar.chaseDistance = car.chaseDistance;
          drawInstrument ??= cockpitWayfinder(instrument,session.wayfinder,district,Boolean(session.taxi?.monitor));
          const instrumentImage = drawInstrument(car);
          if (instrumentImage && session.taxi?.monitor) view.updateWayfinder(instrumentImage);
          view.draw(visibleCar,session.welcome,fade);
          instrument.classList.toggle('chase',Boolean(car.camera));
          instrument.hidden = Boolean(session.taxi?.monitor || (!car.camera && !car.waypoint) || leaving);
          debugConsole.update(now,fps);
          if (leaving && fade === 0) done();
          else animation = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        } catch (error) { fail(error); }
      }
      animation = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    });
  } finally {
    releaseMouse();
    events.abort();
    if (settingsPanel.open) settingsPanel.close();
    effects?.close();
    session.reportCd = null;
    clearTimeout(hideStatus);
    status.hidden = true;
    mouseHint.hidden = true;
    instrument.hidden = true;
    cancelAnimationFrame(animation);
    debugConsole?.destroy();
    view?.close();
    screen.classList.remove('driving');
    screen.classList.remove('hide-cursor');
    screen.width = 320;
    screen.height = 200;
  }
}

export async function runMainMenu(game) {
  const {screen, vga, tables, bytes, loadImage, click} = game;
  let selected = 0, session;
  let rows = coldRows;
  if (game.developerMode) {
    session = await loadFromMenu(game,false);
    if (session) {
      try { await enterCab(game,session); }
      catch (error) { session.disc?.close(); throw error; }
      rows = [0,1,2,4];
      selected = 1;
    }
  }
  const image = await loadImage('OPTION.IMG');
  const choices = readSpriteBank(await bytes('OPTIONC.SPR'), 5);
  function draw() {
    vga.setImage(image);
    vga.sprite(choices[selected], menuX, tables.menuY[selected], true);
    screen.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Main menu. ' + labels[selected] + '. Up, Down, W or S to move. Enter to select. Tilde opens settings.');
    vga.present();
  }
  function rowAt({x, y}) {
    if (x < menuX - 8 || x >= menuX + Math.max(...choices.map(sprite => sprite.width)) + 8) return;
    return rows.find(i => y >= tables.menuY[i]-2 && y < tables.menuY[i]+choices[i].height+2);
  }
  function select(row) {
    if (row === undefined || row === selected) return;
    selected = row;
    click();
    draw();
  }
  screen.focus();
  try {
    for (;;) {
      draw();
      const nextInput = () => readKey(screen, {
        pointerKey: rowAt, pointerHover: position => select(rowAt(position)), activationEvent: 'click',
      });
      let input = nextInput();
      await vga.fade(image.dac, true);
      for (;;) {
        const key = await input;
        if (key === 'Backquote') {
          await openSettings(click);
          draw();
          screen.focus();
          input = nextInput();
          continue;
        }
        if (typeof key === 'number') { select(key); break; }
        if (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ') break;
        const direction = key.toLowerCase();
        const delta = ['arrowdown', 's'].includes(direction) ? 1 : ['arrowup', 'w'].includes(direction) ? -1 : 0;
        select(rows[rows.indexOf(selected) + delta]);
        input = nextInput();
      }
      if (selected === 4) return;
      await vga.fade(image.dac, false);
      if (selected === 2) {
        if (await loadMenu(game)) await loadFromMenu(game, true);
        continue;
      }
      if (selected === 0) {
        const next = await loadFromMenu(game, false);
        if (!next) continue;
        session?.disc?.close();
        session = next;
        rows = [0, 1, 2, 4];
      }
      await enterCab(game, session);
      selected = 1;
    }
  } finally {
    session?.disc?.close();
  }
}

KEMO

The department of 
highway safety and
hover vehicles


The Department of Highway Safety and Hover Vehicles
Omni Corp Building 2473 downtown Kemo.
2184 4th Street
Kemo, Corp Res 1, UCOA


THE DIVISION OF DRIVERS' LICENSES administers examinations to qualify persons to drive on the highways of Kemo. Its primary mission is to promote and maintain the highest possible driving standards on the streets and highways throughout Kemo, holding each driver responsible for his actions in traffic (by use of current, complete and accurate records) and to improve the driving performance of those drivers whose records indicate that they are having problems with their driving. A legitimate secondary mission is to eliminate the very small percentage of extremely poor drivers from the highways after all efforts to improve their driving have failed.

THE DIVISION OF KEMO HIGHWAY PATROL enforces all state laws pertaining to hover vehicles, patrols the state highway system to help ensure the safety of all drivers and implements state traffic safety programs. Each trooper is always willing to render assistance to the hovering public.

THE DIVISION OF MOTOR VEHICLES regulates the sale and distribution of all motor vehicles in Kemo. It administers the sale of license plates through direct levy. If necessary the Division of Motor Vehicles may use force to collect owed debts.

THE DIVISION OF ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES handles the functions of payroll, personnel,purchasing, data processing, accounting and fiscal operations, and maintenance and repair of equipment. The three operating divisions above serve the Administrative Division.

chapter 1

definitions

business district: An area where 50% or more of the land next to the road is used for business.

certified copy: A copy which has been marked in some official way to show that it is a true copy of the original document. To get a certified copy of a document you must contact the agency that issued the original document.

conviction: A judgment of guilt in a court. In a driver's record, suspended sentences, forfeiting/estreatures of bonds, and pleas of no contest count against the driver just as a conviction does.

department: The Department of Highway Safety and Hover Vehicles, Kemo, Corp Res 1, UCOA.

felony: A serious crime from which you can be sent to a state prison or receive a death sentence.

hover vehicle: A car, truck, bus, moped, motorcycle, or any other vehicle that is self propelled by some mechanical or electrical power source and moves without contact with the ground.

gangland: An area where most of the land next to the road is under the control of gangs.

grease: To kill or murder. For example "I will grease him." means "I intend to murder him."

intersection: Where two streets meet or cross.

motor vehicle: A car, truck, bus, moped, motorcycle, or any other vehicle that is self propelled by some mechanical or electrical power source.

pedestrian: Any person walking.

residential district: An area where most of the land next to the road is used for homes.


warning

Under section 6642,167, (5) Kemo statues, it is a FELONY of the third degree "to use a false or fictitious name."


learning to drive

To be a successful driver all applicants must pass a series of simple tests before being issued a driving permit to operate a hover vehicle on the highways of Kemo.




your first driving lesson

Now that we are settled down in your vehicle, let us familiarize ourselves with the layout of your vehicle.

compass: This handy device always tells you which direction you are facing. For those with an interest, the compass is electronic and detects sensors located throughout the city. "Old" compasses no longer work correctly ever since the electromagnetic storm that followed the Pakistan/India nuclear war of 1998.

radar: Ground radar that detects the presence of enemy vehicles. Radar does not detect buildings or streets, only hover vehicles.

steering wheel: Although a highly inefficient form of control, many people insist on using a steering wheel to control their hover vehicles despite the fact that many other more efficient control methods are available.

wayfinder: This device locks onto a certain target (Location/Person, Area or Car) and will always point towards that place. The name of the target (in this case a weapon store) and the distance from the target is given.

battery power: Shows how much off-road power you have remaining.




driving controls

The driving controls for your hover vehicle are very simple indeed. To accelerate, push forward. To brake, pull back. To turn right, push the right key and to turn left, push the left key.

When using the keyboard you will find that the best way to control your vehicle is by tapping the accelerate key irregularly, then "gliding" for a short while before accelerating again.

Press the Z key to jump.


views

To look to the left, press the F1 key.

To look straight ahead, press the F2 key.

To look to the right, press the F3 key.

It is worth remembering that if you have a side arm, then looking out of the side of cab will access the drive by shooting screen.


the map

To access the map type M.

Once on the map view, you can change your waypoint for your Wayfinder by using the arrow keys on your keyboard.

To exit the map screen press ESC.

The map screen gives a lot of important information for finding your way around the city. Following your Wayfinder to all of your fares is not a good policy. Consult your map for a quicker way to your destination.




chapter 2

interpersonal relationships

This section covers picking up fares and dealing with the citizens of Kemo.

vidcam: If you pick up a cab fare, your inboard cameras will display the passenger here.  

fare meter: After you have picked up a fare, you have a certain amount of time to make your delivery. This is displayed here with the amount of money the fare is worth. The fare will slowly tick down after the time elapses.

wayfinder:  After picking up a fare, the Wayfinder will automatically direct you to your destination.


picking up a fare

If you hear someone hail a cab and you see the message "PASSENGER PICKUP" slowly scrolling across the bottom of the screen, then simply bring your vehicle to a stop next to the passenger. The passenger will automatically get on board and the map display will indicate the desired destination or mission. You are then offered the chance to accept or decline the mission.


troublesome people

Sometimes you have a fare who is obnoxious or you may simply feel that there is not enough money in the job for you. To eliminate these troublesome characters, simply press the E key.

Press the E key to eject a passenger or object into the street.




chapter 3

weapons

Life in today's urban society can be stressful and tough on the modern citizen. Fortunately, your vehicle can be upgraded to carry weapons. To purchase weapons simply drive into your nearest weapons shop. After you have purchased your weapons you can select which weapon to fire by the following keys.

Spacebar: Fires your hood machine guns and also fires your Uzi if you are looking out of the side window. Button 1 on Joystick.

Alt: Cycles through your special weapons.

Ctrl: Fires your special weapons. Button 2 on Joystick.


combat

You can fire your hood guns by using the spacebar (top button on a Thrustmaster Steering Wheel). The bullet count is right above your steering wheel.

special weapon: The display on the top of the screen displays the other weapons (if you have purchased some). You can switch between weapons using the Alt key. The remaining ammo is also displayed. To fire the selected weapon, use the Ctrl key (lower button on the Thrustmaster Steering Wheel).



armor

You WILL have to buy armor to survive in Q. You should upgrade as quickly, and as often as you possibly can. Even the lowest level of armor affords good protection. The various levels of armor are as follows.

( STEEL
( REINFORCED STEEL
( PLASTISTEEL

You can also buy TURBO boosts that increase your speed tremendously for a short period of time.




chapter 4

the story

2022 Kemo City is the jewel of the West and the hovercar capital of the world. A prosperous city on the east coast of the United States.

Like any metropolis, Kemo City has a growing crime problem. In Kemo, however, crime has become so widespread, that law enforcement would be both futile and extremely expensive. Talks begin about possible solutions.

2026 Kemo City's crime problem reaches epidemic proportions. The economy slows to a near halt, while crime and black market trading become the only sources of income for Kemo's impoverished inhabitants.

2029 Enter Omnicorp. This Mega Corporation has big plans for Kemo, claiming they can clean up the city and it's crime problem. The project is code named Q.

2030 Construction of a 5 meter thick, 10 meter high wall composed of plasticized concrete and steel begins. Inhabitants are told that the wall is merely a "defensive measure," and that passage in and out of Kemo will be freely granted.

2031 The wall around Kemo nears completion. A few of the lucky inhabitants manage to escape as panic begins to engulf Kemo City.

2032 June 3, the wall is completed and the only exit has sealed shut. Project "Quarantine" is now fully functional and Kemo has become a prison city. Along with isolating the current violent population, Kemo will also serve as a prison for any other violent criminals.

2043 Omnicorp decides to test "Hydergine 344", on the current population, a neurodrug reported to eliminate "criminal thoughts" in patients. Hydergine 344 is introduced into Quarantine's water supply.

2045 Unknown to the designers of Hydergine 344, Kemo's water supply has an abnormal high bacterial and viral content which reacts with Hydergine 344 forming a psychoreactive virus. The virus causes synaptic breakdown, the main symptoms being violent psychopathic tendencies. About half of the prisoners have become crazed violent killer lunatics intent on killing anyone who is not a crazed violent killer lunatic.

2047 The virus is spreading.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                        LAST MINUTE UPDATES & NOTES
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------


TECH STUFF

To run Quarantine you need 4MB XMS. NOT EMS. If you have a 4MB machine.
The most effective way to do this is to rem out your EMM386 line in your
config.sys. Alternatively make a boot disk and run your system clean.
See your DOS manual on how to do this.

SOUND STUFF

Remember that if you have a PC speaker you will hear NO SOUND. The PC speaker
just can't play the samples we require.

All other sound boards should work just fine. If you are having difficulties
simply run the Soundblaster sounds and this should take care of most problems
with non standard sound boards.

GAMEPLAY TIPS

Remeber that at the start your objective is to pick up fares and deliver them.
After 4 regular fares you should get the first special mission. This will be
the package drop off. After around 7 of these special missions you will be
given a password to the next level.

OBEY THE SPEED LIMIT!

Drive slow man. You should never go max speed unless you are on the Highway.
The reason is simple, you simply take a lot more damage and lose a lot of
control when at high speed. Also it is easy to get lost at highspeed. When you
are delivering a fare the worst thing that can happen is getting lost and
losing valuable seconds trying to find the correct way.

DON'T SHOOT UNLESS YA HAVE TO

It's a waste of ammo and most cars you meet are not aggressive (unless you
attack them)




USE THE UZI FOR PED KILLS

If you like doing a hit on peds use the uzi that's what it's there for, and you
will find it much easier to get a good "spread" of kills that way.

JUMP AROUND!

Use your hover coils boost (the Z key) to jump out of trouble.

.\play-avi.js
───────────────────────

import {effectsOutput} from './settings.js';

// The worker reads the local RIFF file and decodes directly into a reusable
// RGB555 buffer. Web Audio is the playback clock for both streams.
export async function playAvi(file, audio, screen, presentFrame, waitForAudio, unlockedBy) {
  const worker = new Worker(new URL('./avi-worker.js', import.meta.url), {type: 'module'});
  const controls = new AbortController();
  let animationFrame, source, started = false;
  try {
    const movie = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      worker.onmessage = ({data}) => {
        if (data.error) reject(new Error(data.error));
        else resolve(data);
      };
      worker.onerror = event => reject(new Error(event.message || 'Unable to load the AVI decoder.'));
      worker.postMessage({file});
    });

    const {pcm, frameCount, sampleRate, secondsPerFrame} = movie;
    const audioBuffer = audio.createBuffer(1, pcm.length, sampleRate);
    const samples = audioBuffer.getChannelData(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) samples[i] = (pcm[i] - 128) / 128;
    source = audio.createBufferSource();
    source.buffer = audioBuffer;
    source.connect(effectsOutput(audio));

    let pixels = movie.pixels;
    let current = 0;
    const duration = Math.max(frameCount * secondsPerFrame, audioBuffer.duration);
    presentFrame(pixels);
    await waitForAudio();
    const startedAt = audio.currentTime;
    source.start(startedAt);
    started = true;

    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const options = {signal: controls.signal};
      const skip = event => { if (!unlockedBy(event)) resolve(); };
      document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (event.key !== ' ' && event.key !== 'Escape') return;
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!event.repeat) skip(event);
      }, options);
      screen.addEventListener('click', skip, options);

      worker.onerror = event => reject(new Error(event.message || 'AVI decoder stopped.'));
      worker.onmessage = ({data}) => {
        if (data.error) {
          reject(new Error(data.error));
          return;
        }
        pixels = data.pixels;
        current = data.frame;
        try {
          presentFrame(pixels);
        } catch (error) {
          reject(error);
        }
      };

      function tick() {
        const elapsed = audio.currentTime - startedAt;
        if (elapsed >= duration && current === frameCount - 1) {
          resolve();
          return;
        }
        const target = Math.min(frameCount - 1, Math.floor(elapsed / secondsPerFrame));
        if (pixels && current !== target) {
          worker.postMessage({frame: target, pixels}, [pixels]);
          pixels = null;
        }
        animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      }
      animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    });
  } finally {
    controls.abort();
    cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
    worker.terminate();
    if (started) source.stop();
    source?.disconnect();
  }
}

.\postprocess.js
──────────────────────────

// The scaler works on RGB after palette lookup; the other passes work at the
// final output size so neither depends on the source's indexed representation.
const shader = `
struct Params { output: vec2f, fxaa: f32, sharpness: f32, xbr: f32 };
@group(0) @binding(0) var source: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var linearSampler: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> params: Params;

@vertex fn vertex(@builtin(vertex_index) i:u32) -> @builtin(position) vec4f {
  let p = vec2f(f32((i<<1u)&2u),f32(i&2u));
  return vec4f(p*2.0-1.0,0,1);
}
fn pixel(p:vec2i) -> vec3f {
  return textureLoad(source,clamp(p,vec2i(0),vec2i(textureDimensions(source))-1),0).rgb;
}
fn distance(a:vec3f,b:vec3f) -> f32 {
  let d = a-b;
  return abs(dot(d,vec3f(0.299,0.587,0.114)))+
    0.5*abs(dot(d,vec3f(-0.169,-0.331,0.5)))+
    0.5*abs(dot(d,vec3f(0.5,-0.419,-0.081)));
}
@fragment fn upscale(@builtin(position) pos:vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f {
  let size = vec2f(textureDimensions(source));
  let loc = pos.xy*size/params.output;
  let p = vec2i(floor(loc));
  let e = pixel(p);
  if (params.xbr == 0.0) { return vec4f(e,1); }
  let f = fract(loc);
  let side = vec2i(select(-1,1,f.x>=0.5),select(-1,1,f.y>=0.5));
  let h = pixel(p+vec2i(side.x,0));
  let v = pixel(p+vec2i(0,side.y));
  let diagonal = pixel(p+side);
  let upper = pixel(p+vec2i(side.x,-side.y));
  let left = pixel(p+vec2i(-side.x,side.y));
  let outerH = pixel(p+vec2i(2*side.x,0));
  let outerV = pixel(p+vec2i(0,2*side.y));
  let cornerH = pixel(p+vec2i(2*side.x,side.y));
  let cornerV = pixel(p+vec2i(side.x,2*side.y));
  let oppositeH = pixel(p+vec2i(-side.x,0));
  let oppositeV = pixel(p+vec2i(0,-side.y));
  let across = distance(e,upper)+distance(e,left)+distance(diagonal,outerV)+
    distance(diagonal,outerH)+4.0*distance(h,v);
  let along = distance(v,oppositeH)+distance(v,cornerV)+distance(h,cornerH)+
    distance(h,oppositeV)+4.0*distance(e,diagonal);
  let nearest = select(v,h,distance(e,h)<=distance(e,v));
  let corner = select(1.0-f,f,side==vec2i(1));
  let blend = select(clamp((corner.x+corner.y-1.0)*2.0,0.0,1.0),0.0,
    across >= along || distance(e,h) < 0.001 || distance(e,v) < 0.001);
  return vec4f(mix(e,nearest,blend),1);
}
fn luminance(c:vec3f) -> f32 { return dot(c,vec3f(0.299,0.587,0.114)); }
fn sampleAt(uv:vec2f) -> vec3f { return textureSampleLevel(source,linearSampler,uv,0).rgb; }
@fragment fn fxaa(@builtin(position) pos:vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f {
  let uv = pos.xy/params.output;
  let step = 1.0/params.output;
  let m = sampleAt(uv);
  if (params.fxaa == 0.0) { return vec4f(m,1); }
  let nw = luminance(sampleAt(uv+step*vec2f(-1,-1)));
  let ne = luminance(sampleAt(uv+step*vec2f(1,-1)));
  let sw = luminance(sampleAt(uv+step*vec2f(-1,1)));
  let se = luminance(sampleAt(uv+step*vec2f(1,1)));
  let lm = luminance(m);
  let lo = min(lm,min(min(nw,ne),min(sw,se)));
  let hi = max(lm,max(max(nw,ne),max(sw,se)));
  var dir = vec2f(-((nw+ne)-(sw+se)),(nw+sw)-(ne+se));
  let reduce = max((nw+ne+sw+se)*0.03125,0.0078125);
  dir = clamp(dir/(min(abs(dir.x),abs(dir.y))+reduce),vec2f(-8),vec2f(8))*step;
  let a = 0.5*(sampleAt(uv+dir*(-1.0/6.0))+sampleAt(uv+dir*(1.0/6.0)));
  let b = a*0.5+0.25*(sampleAt(uv-dir*0.5)+sampleAt(uv+dir*0.5));
  let lb = luminance(b);
  let filtered = mix(m,select(b,a,lb<lo || lb>hi),params.fxaa);
  return vec4f(select(m,filtered,hi-lo >= max(0.0312,hi*0.125)),1);
}
fn linear(c:vec3f) -> vec3f {
  return select(pow((c+0.055)/1.055,vec3f(2.4)),c/12.92,c<=vec3f(0.04045));
}
fn srgb(c:vec3f) -> vec3f {
  let value = clamp(c,vec3f(0),vec3f(1));
  return select(1.055*pow(value,vec3f(1.0/2.4))-0.055,12.92*value,value<=vec3f(0.0031308));
}
@fragment fn sharpen(@builtin(position) pos:vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f {
  let p = vec2i(pos.xy);
  let center = pixel(p);
  if (params.sharpness == 0.0) { return vec4f(center,1); }
  let e = linear(center);
  let n = linear(pixel(p+vec2i(0,-1)));
  let s = linear(pixel(p+vec2i(0,1)));
  let w = linear(pixel(p+vec2i(-1,0)));
  let t = linear(pixel(p+vec2i(1,0)));
  let lo = min(e,min(min(n,s),min(w,t)));
  let hi = max(e,max(max(n,s),max(w,t)));
  let gain = sqrt(clamp(min(lo,1.0-hi)/max(hi,vec3f(0.00001)),vec3f(0),vec3f(1)));
  let weight = -params.sharpness*gain/8.0;
  return vec4f(srgb((e+weight*(n+s+w+t))/(1.0+4.0*weight)),1);
}`;

export async function createPostprocess(device,format) {
  const module = device.createShaderModule({code:shader});
  const layout = device.createBindGroupLayout({entries:[
    {binding:0,visibility:GPUShaderStage.FRAGMENT,texture:{sampleType:'float'}},
    {binding:1,visibility:GPUShaderStage.FRAGMENT,sampler:{type:'filtering'}},
    {binding:2,visibility:GPUShaderStage.FRAGMENT,buffer:{type:'uniform'}},
  ]});
  const pipelineLayout = device.createPipelineLayout({bindGroupLayouts:[layout]});
  const pipelines = await Promise.all(['upscale','fxaa','sharpen'].map(entryPoint =>
    device.createRenderPipelineAsync({layout:pipelineLayout,vertex:{module,entryPoint:'vertex'},
      fragment:{module,entryPoint,targets:[{format}]},primitive:{topology:'triangle-list'}})));
  const sampler = device.createSampler({minFilter:'linear',magFilter:'linear'});
  const uniform = device.createBuffer({size:32,usage:GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM|GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST});
  let scene, first, second, sizes;
  function target(w,h) {
    return device.createTexture({size:[w,h],format,
      usage:GPUTextureUsage.RENDER_ATTACHMENT|GPUTextureUsage.TEXTURE_BINDING});
  }
  function release() {
    scene?.destroy(); first?.destroy(); second?.destroy();
    scene = first = second = sizes = undefined;
  }
  return {
    target(sw,sh,ow,oh) {
      if (!sizes || sizes.some((n,i) => n !== [sw,sh,ow,oh][i])) {
        release();
        scene = target(sw,sh); first = target(ow,oh); second = target(ow,oh);
        sizes = [sw,sh,ow,oh];
      }
      return scene.createView();
    },
    present(encoder,output,settings) {
      const [sw,sh,ow,oh] = sizes;
      device.queue.writeBuffer(uniform,0,new Float32Array([ow,oh,settings.fxaa/100,settings.sharpen/100,
        Number(settings.upscale > 1 && (ow > sw || oh > sh)),0,0,0]));
      const sources = [scene,first,second], destinations = [first.createView(),second.createView(),output];
      for (let i=0; i<pipelines.length; i++) {
        const group = device.createBindGroup({layout:pipelines[i].getBindGroupLayout(0),entries:[
          {binding:0,resource:sources[i].createView()},{binding:1,resource:sampler},{binding:2,resource:{buffer:uniform}}]});
        const pass = encoder.beginRenderPass({colorAttachments:[{view:destinations[i],loadOp:'clear',storeOp:'store',
          clearValue:[0,0,0,1]}]});
        pass.setPipeline(pipelines[i]); pass.setBindGroup(0,group); pass.draw(3); pass.end();
      }
    },
    release,
  };
}

──────────────────────────────

Welcome to the Quarantine Playable Demo

Change to the directory into which the demo was installed, then
run the install program by typing 
INSTALL  [enter]
The install program will help you set up your 
keyboard/Thrustmaster steering wheel and sound device.

To run the game type
QDEMO    [enter]

Sound: 
At this time only  DMA 1, 220 address, is supported, however the IRQ can be
changed.

Quick Keyboard Reference:

Steering           - Right and left arrow keys
Accelerate         - Up arrow key
Brake / Reverse    - Down arrow key
Spacebar           - Hood Guns
M                  - Map
Esc                - Exit to Main Menu
ALT                - Select Weapon
CNTRL              - Fire Weapon
ENTER              - Horn
J                  - Jump
N                  - Nitro Boost (Argon Cells)
Q                  - Normal resolution
W                  - Low resolution(Faster screen updates)
F1                 - Look Left
F2                 - Look Ahead
F3                 - Look Right
F10                - "Curse key"

How to play:
The object of Quarantine is to escape Kemo, a prison city.  
Kemo contains five separate areas surrounded by impenetrable walls.  

Kemo's areas include :

Downtown Core- A shopping mall, highway, glass, steel and concrete. *

The Park - An open air park with canals, zoo of horrors, and scenic canyon
just to name a few highlights.

Old Kemo - Old markets, Classy residential areas, commercial districts 
and hospitals surround these tight and twisty roads.

Projects - Burning housing projects, a football stadium, and a power plant 
are a few attractions in this shell-shocked warzone.

The Wharf - Perpetually raining, the wharf contains a harbor, rail yard and 
possible escape...

*****************************************************
* Only the Downtown Core is available in this demo. *
*****************************************************

The Object:
You are Drake Edgewater, a cab driver driving a hovercab armed only with 
headlight-mounted machine-guns.  
To escape from Quarantine you must arm your vehicle with weapons, 
discover secret entrances and travel in the underground from area to area.  
To earn money,  you can pick up and deliver passengers.


!****  NOTE: In this demo all missions and plot advancement has been removed!
You can only pickup and drop off passengers and purchase weapons. In the full
game you will learn the complete story, and take on special missions to 
advance in the game.


How to Play:

Picking up passengers.

To pick up a passenger, drive around wherever you like.  
If you see a passenger waving at you, stop next to him or her.  
You will be shown a map of the Downtown Core.  The yellow arrow represents 
your current location in the city and a line indicates where to passenger 
would like to go. The estimated time of travel will be indicated in the 
lower left corner.  You will only get paid if you can deliver the passenger 
ON TIME!  You can accept or reject the fare by typing 'Y' or 'N'

Delivering a passenger.
In the cab view, a wayfinder in the lower right of the dashboard will 
indicate the distance and direction of your destination.  When the arrow is 
pointing up, you are headed in the right direction.  A compass above your 
windshield will also help you navigate.  You'll still have to do some of your 
own navigating, so if you get lost check the map by typing 'M'. A meter on the 
left side of the dashboard displays how much time is left and how much money 
you have in total.
When you reach the passenger's destination the wayfinder arrow will spin and 
the distance meter will display zero kilometers.  To drop the passenger off, 
you must stop completely on the exact destination.  The passenger will 
proceed to leave the cab and pay your fee.  If you were late, the passenger 
will pay you a reduced amount or possibly nothing, so try to be prompt!  

Navigating the Downtown Core:
Typing 'M' will bring up a map of Kemo.  If you are without a passenger you 
can set your wayfinder to any of a number of service and weapon bays.  Move 
the cursor to your desired destination with the 'arrow keys' then hit the 
spacebar.  The wayfinder will now be set to the service or weapon bay of your 
choice.  The wayfinder arrow works the same way it does when you have a 
passeng\er.  Kemo security has set up perimeter defenses around the outside 
walls of each area.  It is not advisable to use them as regular routes.

Driving:
You will be driving a modified 1952 Checker equipped with 'hovercoils'.  
Under the roads are superconductive cables providing the 'lift' which all of 
Kemo's vehicles require.  For travel off the 'power grid', batteries may be 
purchased.  Downtown Core has so few areas without a powergrid that batteries 
will not be needed in this demo.  Use the arrow keys to steer, accelerate and 
brake.
You can look out the side windows using the 'F1' or 'F3' keys and 'F2' to 
look straight ahead.

Arming yourself:
Kemo (being a prison city affected by a mind altering corporate drug 
experiment) is prone to a lot of violence.  Someone may get in your way so 
you must be equipped to deal with it.  The game starts with hood guns and 
250 bullets. Of course you probably crave MORE firepower!  In the weapon bays 
you can find a variety of weapons and ammo to suit your cab driving needs.  
Use the arrow keys and spacebar to navigate the menus.  All weapons come 
fully loaded with the maximum capacity of ammo.  If you buy another weapon of 
the same class, (Roof mounted, right fender, missile launcher or mine rack) 
you will be refunded for the existing weapon.

Combat:

You can fire your hood guns by using the spacebar (top button on a 
Thrustmaster Steering Wheel).  The bullet count is right above your steering 
wheel.
The display on the top of the screen displays the other weapons (if you have 
purchased some).  You can switch between weapons using the 'ALT' key.  The 
remaining ammo is also displayed.  To fire the selected weapon use the 'CNTRL' 
key (lower button on the Thrustmaster Steering Wheel).

Gates:

You may notice steel gates blocking the road from time to time.  The gates 
are controlled by Kemo Security.  The only way to get through them is by 
taking a passenger through whose destination is on the inside of the area.

W key:

If you have a slower machine we have incorporated a low res mode. Pressing
the 'W' key will activate this mode enabling much higher screen refreshes.
Press 'Q' to return to normal resolution.


Requirements:

386/33, 486/33 recomended
MSDOS
4 megs of RAM
640K Conventional Memory
Sound Blaster (optional)
Thrustmaster steering wheel (optional)
Joystick not implemented for DEMO!

-If there are problems running this demo on a 4 meg machine, try to disable 
smartdrv to allow for the required 4 megs. Also disabling any memory managers 
would be helpfull. Another option is to create a minimum boot disk.


The Story:
2022 Kemo City is the jewel of the West and the hovercar capital of the world.  
A prosperous city on the east coast of the United States.
Like any metropolis, Kemo City has a growing crime problem.  The inner ghetto 
area of Kemo is perceived to be a money pit where any law enforcement would be 
both futile and frivolous.  The solution is to make the old "inner Kemo" a 
demilitarized zone.

2026 Kemo City's crime problem reaches epidemic proportions.  The economy in 
the "inner Kemo" slows to a near halt.  Crime and black market trading are 
the only sources of income for inner Kemo's impoverished inhabitants.  The 
new markets and commercial districts form a ring around  "inner Kemo", but 
citizens are still stalked by the cesspool of criminal activity in the deadly 
ghetto.

2029 Ray Larabie is elected as mayor of New Kemo.  One of Ray's campaign 
promises is to build a wall around inner Kemo and eliminate the crime 
problem; the project is simply codenamed "Q".  The wall will contain a park, 
market, housing project, office core, and industrial coastal area.

2030  A ring of properties are purchased by the government around inner Kemo 
at very reasonable prices.  An armed citizen's task force assembles in 
opposition to project "Q".  Unmanned and well armored construction vehicles 
begin construction of a  5 meter thick, 10 meter high wall composed of 
plasticized concrete and steel.  Inhabitants of inner Kemo are told that the 
wall is merely a sound baffle and gates will allow passage to New Kemo.  
Within Kemo, the city is being sectioned off into five sections: Downtown 
Core, Old Kemo, Kemo Park, the Projects and the Wharf.

2031  The wall around inner Kemo nears completion.  A few of inner Kemo's 
inhabitants leave, but most return after finding no work opportunities in New 
Kemo.  Only one route leads in and out of the city, and a military presence 
is established at the lone exit.

2032  After an armed standoff,  Kemo is completely sealed off.  The only 
possible exit is the coastline, which is sealed off by an armada of 
battleships and gunboats.  Any material entering of leaving Kemo must go 
through Kemo Security.  Wanderers and criminals outside project "Q" are 
hunted down and returned by airship to their rightful place.  Outside walls 
are strewn with mines and turrets. The prison city of Quarantine is 
officially opened

2035  After three years of tribal gang wars, a citizen's committee is 
established to restore support systems such as electric power, proper food 
distribution, water filtration and activation of the old street power grids 
which support the thousands of unused hover vehicles which lay useless in the 
streets.  The gang kingpins take notice and openly support and protect the 
committee to have some of the comforts they are otherwise unable to acquire 
(including driving cool cars!).

2046  The quarantined Kemo city is doing fairly well, but unfortunately due 
to the influx of new inmates, overcrowding is becoming a problem.  New Kemo's 
OmniCorp raises public interest in the neurodrug "Hydergine 344" reported to 
eliminate "criminal thoughts" in patients.

2047  Hydergine 344 is introduced to Quarantine's water supply.  The water 
supply has an abnormally high bacterial and viral content which reacts with 
Hydergine 344 forming a pychoreactive virus.  The virus causes synaptic 
breakdown, the main symptoms being violent psychopathic tendencies.  About 
half of the prisoners have become crazed violent killer lunatics intent on 
killing anyone who is not a crazed violent killer lunatic.  

2048  The virus is spreading.



HINT:  Buy the forward guns with a free UZI then look out of your side 
view while driving. 


The final version has loads of areas super detailed mission breifings and 
loads more enemies & pedestrians and well.... the other 90% of the game!

It will be out by September so start saving your Earth dollars. 

Enjoy
